name: rqbit
author: Viboplr
description: Find and download music over BitTorrent with no torrent client to set up: search torrent sites, pick single tracks or take whole albums, or paste a magnet link. rqbit fetches each one as a one-shot run — nothing keeps running in the background.

permissionReasons.network:apibay.org: Search The Pirate Bay for music torrents
permissionReasons.network:nyaa.si: Search Nyaa's audio category for music torrents
permissionReasons.exec:rqbit: Download each torrent, or list its files, in a one-shot rqbit run
permissionReasons.library:read: List your local collections so you can choose where downloads land
permissionReasons.library:write: Rescan the destination collection when a download finishes so the files reach your library
permissionReasons.files:read: Read a downloaded track's title, artist and album from the file instead of guessing from its name
permissionReasons.files:trash: Remove the partial files a failed or cancelled download leaves in your collection
permissionReasons.system:open: Open a finished download's folder or your destination collection

viewHeader.subtitle: Download music over BitTorrent into your library

binaryDependencies.name: rqbit
binaryDependencies.reason: The BitTorrent client that performs each download
